0x009FAE: Pilots of humanoid mobile weapons once raised at the <School>. Kinless children with superior reflexes and dynamic vision underwent mind control, drugs, and special training. Memories were erased on entry, and severe <Limacon> destroyed many minds. Arado, Seolla, and Latooni are among the few survivors.
0x00A212: Human life energy, akin to aura or ki. It cloaks the body and swells with emotion. <La Gias> natives show smaller swings than surface folk.
0x00A339: An interstellar flight program using mid-sized ships, begun under the <DC>. It develops starships and trains their pilots. After the DC fell it continued under Federation control, backed by <Isurugi Heavy Industries>; its craft and systems also see military use. "TD" means "<Tesla Drive>" and "Terrestrial Dream."
0x00A571:
A spherical super-large space fortress used by the <Aerogaters> as their base in the <L5 Campaign>. Formally the "Automated Planet Neviim"; "White Star" was Earth's codename. With mobile weapon plants, a spaceport, a 1G housing block with simulated weather, and multiple farms, it is virtually a mobile colony. One theory says it was to carry warlike humans back to the Aerogater homeworld, but this is unproven.
Crippled late in the L5 Campaign by the Operation SRW allied fleet's assault, it passed to Earth Federation Army control. In New Era 187 the invading <Inspectors> seized it as their base. It later fused with Neue Regisseur, leader of the <Einst>, becoming the giant weapon Stern Regisseur, and vanished after a fierce battle with the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom in another dimension.
0x00AAFB: XA heavy machinery maker Tin Mao founded in New Era 176 with Yuan Meilun and others in the lunar city Celevis. It first built bipedal lunar work machines but now mainly develops and makes Personal Troopers. Its president is Tin's daughter, Ring Mao.
0x00ACCF: Self-repairing, self-evolving metal cells made by Dr. Egret Feff. They can also invade matter, quickly rewriting a touched object's composition to strengthen it and take control. Development predates the <DC War>, but a sample of the self-aware metal cells (Zfylud Crystal) in <Aerogaters> weapons boosted them greatly. In the <Inspector Incident> they were also used in the <Neue DC> machines Thrudgelmir and Bergelmir, showing remarkable regeneration.
0x00B02D: Humanoid weapons of <La Gias>. Once meaning only the Holy Kingdom of Langran's sixteen machines, the term now covers all such units since mass-produced types appeared.
